sections.title: Valuation Insights
sections.text: Costco reports an operating margin of [[COST.ratio.operating_margin]], indicating modest profitability on sales. Its return on average equity of [[COST.ratio.return_on_average_equity]] demonstrates strong earnings generation relative to equity. The debt‑to‑equity ratio of [[COST.ratio.debt_to_equity]] reflects a conservative capital structure, while free cash flow of [[COST.ratio.free_cash_flow]] provides ample liquidity for shareholder returns. The annual price‑earnings multiple of [[COST.ratio.price_earnings]] suggests a premium valuation compared with broader retail peers.

insight.text: Costco's return on average equity of [[COST.ratio.return_on_average_equity]] highlights its efficiency in turning shareholders' capital into earnings, a core component of intrinsic valuation.
